criterion_text: Two optional build-time settings independently select the fixed terminal columns and Web preferred/max CSS font size without source changes; omitted values use approved defaults, invalid inputs fail the build, and Web/mobile use the same embedded cols while existing Sessions never silently change width.

verifiers.summary: Two optional build inputs independently select columns and the Web maximum font; defaults and fail-fast cases are proven by real builds

evidence.value: exact SHA a1f37afcb3987019a59e08be00621a420fbc9bde: isolated Web builds emitted 80/13, 96/14 and default 80/14 via WEB_TERMINAL_CONFIG_V1; both inputs report source="env" only when supplied
VITE_NESSION_TERMINAL_COLS=0 and VITE_NESSION_TERMINAL_WEB_FONT_SIZE=14px each failed the build visibly and produced no index.html
a font-only change (12px vs 18px at cols=96) changed only web_max_font_size; the shared terminalConfig unit tests passed and no mobile columns value exists
